headword: {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}

definitions.explanation: A device or service that automatically answers phone calls and records messages when the recipient is unavailable. In modern usage, often refers to the voicemail function on mobile phones.

examples.japanese: {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: I left a message on the answering machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}られない→出る：00513_deru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わります→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧。
examples.english: When I can't answer the phone, it switches to voicemail.

examples.japanese: {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}したら→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When I checked my voicemail, there was a message from the hospital.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{留守番|るすばん}→留守番：15546_rusuban⟧ (house-sitting, looking after the house while someone is out) + ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (telephone). Literally "house-watching telephone" — a phone that answers on your behalf while you are away.

FORMS:
Often shortened to ⟦{留守電|るすでん}→留守電：07686_rusuden⟧ in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (to leave a voicemail)
- {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check voicemail)
- {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧ (to switch to voicemail)
